description: This file defines the PersistableProductPopulator class, which extends AbstractDataPopulator to convert a PersistableProduct into a Product entity. It includes methods to populate product details, descriptions, images, attributes, categories, and associated services for data conversion within a Java-based e-commerce application.

classes.name: PersistableProductPopulator
classes.description: A class responsible for converting a PersistableProduct into a Product entity, handling complex mappings including descriptions, images, attributes, categories, and related services.
